metadata.description: Collection of plugins for creating Claude Code extensions and building production-grade agentic workflows

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Helps create new Claude skills with specialized knowledge, workflows, and tools

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Helps create complete Claude Code plugins with commands, agents, hooks, skills, and MCP integrations

plugins.name: agentic-flow-builder
plugins.description: Build dynamic agentic workflows using ReAcTree hierarchical decomposition, business rules engine for deterministic gates, and Anthropic's workflow patterns with full audit trails

plugins.name: prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Expert prompt optimization for LLMs and AI systems. Proactively improves prompts using proven techniques, patterns, and model-specific optimization. Uses Opus for advanced reasoning.

plugins.name: prd-quality-gate-flow
plugins.description: Production-grade PRD (Product Requirements Document) workflow system with 7 quality gates, business rules engine for deterministic decisions, episodic memory, and complete audit trails. Implements evidence-based Stage-Gate process with 60% defect reduction and 138% ROI.

plugins.name: research-agent
plugins.description: Production-grade research agent with auto-detection of 5 research types (Exploratory, Descriptive, Explanatory, Evaluative, Comparative), academic frameworks (PICO, SPICE, PECO, GRADE, ReAct), systematic review protocol, root cause analysis patterns (5 Whys + Fishbone), and prompt-engineered research patterns for source-backed, bias-aware investigations.

plugins.name: delivery-team
plugins.description: Delivery Team agent specializing in agile product management artifacts. Produces user stories with INVEST validation, epic decompositions, prioritized backlogs (MoSCoW, RICE, WSJF, Kano), PRDs, sprint plans, roadmap items, and stakeholder communications. Designed for both standalone use and multi-agent orchestration flows.
